metadata.question: Did the water extent of Elephant Butte Reservoir decrease between June 12, 1986 and June 9, 2020

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: Landsat (Landsat 5 for 1986, Landsat 8 for 2020) - Dates: June 12, 1986 (±10 days) and June 9, 2020 (±10 days) - Location: Elephant Butte Reservoir, New Mexico (approximately 32.28°N, 107.18°W) - Need to calculate water extent for both dates and compare 2. Masking strategy: - Use NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) to identify water - NDWI = (Green - NIR) / (Green + NIR) - Threshold NDWI > 0.3 to identify water pixels - Mask clouds using QA band 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Check if collections have images: `.size().getInfo()` - Check pixel counts after water masking: if 0, output C2 - Compare water extents: if valid values exist, compare and answer A (decrease) or B (increase/no change) - If any calculation fails (None/NaN), output C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Elephant Butte Reservoir location const reservoir = ee.Geometry.Point([-107.18, 32.28]); const bufferZone = reservoir.buffer(15000); // 15km buffer for water body // Date ranges for comparison const date1Start = '1986-06-02'; const date1End = '1986-06-22'; const date2Start = '2020-05-30'; const date2End = '2020-06-19'; // 1986 - Landsat 5 let col1986 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(bufferZone) .filterDate(date1Start, date1End) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); let size1986 = col1986.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1986 Images found: ${size1986}`); if (size1986 === 0) { console.log("No data for 1986."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 2020 - Landsat 8 let col2020 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(bufferZone) .filterDate(date2Start, date2End) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); let size2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2020 Images found: ${size2020}`); if (size2020 === 0) { console.log("No data for 2020."); console.log("C1"); return; } // Function to calculate water extent using NDWI function calcWaterExtent(col, isSR) { let img = col.median(); let ndwi; if (isSR) { // Landsat 5: SR_B2=Green, SR_B4=NIR ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B2', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDWI'); } else { // Landsat 8: SR_B3=Green, SR_B5=NIR ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B5']).rename('NDWI'); } // Water threshold: NDWI > 0.3 let waterMask = ndwi.gt(0.3); let waterExtent = waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: bufferZone, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); return waterExtent.get('NDWI'); } // Calculate water extent for both dates let water1986 = calcWaterExtent(col1986, true); let water2020 = calcWaterExtent(col2020, false); water1986 = water1986.getInfo(); water2020 = water2020.getInfo(); console.log(`1986 Water pixels: ${water1986}`); console.log(`2020 Water pixels: ${water2020}`); // Validate results if (water1986 === null || water1986 === 0) { console.log("No valid water pixels detected in 1986."); console.log("C2"); return; } if (water2020 === null || water2020 === 0) { console.log("No valid water pixels detected in 2020."); console.log("C2"); return; } // Compare water extents console.log(`1986 Water extent: ${water1986} pixels`); console.log(`2020 Water extent: ${water2020} pixels`); let change = water2020 - water1986; let percentChange = (change / water1986) * 100; console.log(`Change: ${change} pixels (${percentChange.toFixed(2)}%)`); // Determine answer if (water2020 < water1986) { console.log("Water extent DECREASED"); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Water extent did NOT decrease"); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
